# Teleport

> Hardened TeleportService wrapper: retries, reserved servers, teleport data.

- Package: `Teleport` · Category: Data & players
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Teleport")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.Teleport`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/TeleportService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Teleport = GaxiaServer.Teleport
```
